score_reasons.quality: Isometric cutaway rendering is crisp and dense, with coherent light, layered strata and clean building edges; however every side panel carries a line of illegible pseudo-English caption text and the 24h timeline digits are partly deformed, which are visible resolution/text artifacts.
score_reasons.aesthetics: Pleasant scientific-atlas composition: light paper background, muted harmonious palette, clear above/below-ground split with good visual hierarchy; side panels are slightly repetitive and the center is very busy but readable.
score_reasons.alignment: Shows above-ground city and below-ground pipes/tunnels/tanks/bedrock with color-coded flows, a data-center block, water tank, geothermal rods and a 24h timeline as requested. All 12 panel topics appear, but the numbering is broken (物流 mislabeled 02 duplicating 水循环, 地质 shown as garbled 89, 公共服务 numbered both 08 and 10), the required bilingual CN/EN captions are garbled instead of legible English, and the aspect ratio is vertical but visibly wider than exact 9:16.
score_reasons.real_world_fidelity: Infrastructure types (subway, utility tunnels, water/sewage/gas loops, aquifer, bedrock) are plausibly rendered and culturally neutral; icons (recycling, sun, cloud) are conventional; only the fake English captions undercut the white-paper authenticity.
score_reasons.creative_generation: Ambitious and imaginative multi-layer atlas with a coherent information hierarchy between icon panels and central cutaway; seamless fusion of many systems, though garbled captions weaken the intended informational precision.
